verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs say it automatically captures diagnostics for every error occurrence. There is a JavaScript crash-reporting language guide covering source maps for the frontend, and a .NET SDK changelog entry (SendInBackground) plus community praise for open-source .NET and WinRT providers cover the backend and apps. Support for uploading iOS dSYMs and Android ProGuard mappings implies mobile crash reporting. The 2013 launch-era comments that JS and Python support was missing are outdated and are contradicted by the current JS guide, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: an explicit official SDK catalog across web, backend and mobile; docs describing automatic uncaught-exception handlers per platform; direct mobile SDK documentation rather than inference from symbol-upload features.
